# release-policy

> Reusable GitHub Actions workflows for releases, provenance attestations, VirusTotal
> scans, attribution checks and independent PR reviews, shared by Ryan Duguid's
> repositories. Consumers pin a full policy commit. Policy checks establish release
> evidence, not accounting correctness.

This repository has no package installation command. `v0.4.0` is the latest release, with
executables for Linux, macOS arm64 and Windows; `v0.3.0` (28 October 2026) was the first
release with an artefact; `v0.1.0` and `v0.2.0` are notes-only source markers, not
distributable releases.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/ryanduguid/release-policy#readme): the recorded consumer canary, release status and consumer guides.
- [Guarantees and canary evidence](https://github.com/ryanduguid/release-policy/blob/main/docs/guarantees-and-evidence.md): what the policy does and does not establish, including what is unverified about SLSA Build Level 3.
- [canaries.json](https://github.com/ryanduguid/release-policy/blob/main/canaries.json): each consumer's source commit, policy SHA and run identity.
